title: Why inflation is so high at the moment, and why it matters
paragraphs: If you are feeling the squeeze at the check-out, official data confirms what your receipt likely shows: prices keep rising.
In August, headline inflation jumped to 4 per cent from 3.5 per cent in July, driven by higher housing costs and automotive fuel prices.
At 11:30am AEDT, we will learn the September inflation rate.
